1985. Steve Jobs was fired... from the company he started.
He was thirty years old. And the world said he was finished.
So, he started over. A new computer company... called NeXT.
Then he bought a tiny graphics lab from George Lucas... and called it Pixar.
People laughed. A failing tech guy... betting on computer cartoons?
For years, it lost money. And he kept writing the checks.
The first feature film ever made entirely on a computer.
Overnight, a whole new art form was born.
And yet... thirty years later, 3D still feels out of reach for most people.
Expensive software. Steep learning curves. Ideas, trapped behind complexity.
Steve once said... Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
At Vi3W, we're building on that belief. Sketch an idea... and watch it become 3D, right in your browser.
I miss Steve... And I wonder what he'd think of a world where anyone can create what they imagine.
We're building that future. One sketch at a time.
